A home hangs in the canopy above a carved counterweight stone. Yellow-green light moves behind its windows. Use the hanging home as the Act 4 hub: exterior puzzle, Custodian RP, and reveal chamber. Hanging cabin, giant rope braid, carved counterweight boulder, yellow-green window light, trees covered in hundreds of carved watching faces, blue glowing moss starting on the nearby crops. The slow creak of the swaying cabin; the Custodian's clear, expressive voice once she emerges; a low hum from the carved faces when the wind moves. potions, dried herbs, beeswax, old wood — a cluttered-but-precise workshop. Uncanny watchfulness (the faces); the cabin's gentle motion; the sense that nothing here is accidental. Small creatures of all kinds inside the cabin; potion bottles, spellbooks, runes, plants — crowded but immaculately...
